import re

# --- Inputs ---
invitees_path='~/documents/personal/preparation_for_baby_shower/invitees.md'
draft_id=518

def parse_name(full):
    parts=[p for p in full.strip().split() if p]
    if len(parts)==1:
        return parts[0], ''
    return parts[0], ' '.join(parts[1:])

# --- Login tokens ---
fs_pw=[p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='file_system'][0]['password']
g_pw=[p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='gmail'][0]['password']
phone_pw=[p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='phone'][0]['password']

fs_login=apis.file_system.login(username='mi.burch@gmail.com', password=fs_pw)
gmail_login=apis.gmail.login(username='mi.burch@gmail.com', password=g_pw)
phone_login=apis.phone.login(username='8095050664', password=phone_pw)

fs_token=fs_login['access_token']
gmail_token= gmail_login['access_token']
phone_token= phone_login['access_token']

# --- Load invitees ---
invitees_content=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=invitees_path)['content']
invitees=[l[2:].strip() for l in invitees_content.splitlines() if l.strip().startswith('- ')]

# --- Load template from Gmail draft ---
draft=apis.gmail.show_draft(access_token=gmail_token, draft_id=draft_id)
subject=draft['subject']
body_template=draft['body']

# --- Extract placeholders ---
placeholders=set(re.findall(r"\{([^{}]+)\}", body_template))

# --- Build personalized payloads & resolve emails via phone contacts ---

def resolve_email_for_full_name(full_name):
    first,last=parse_name(full_name)
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    results=[]
    while True:
        res=apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query=full_name, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not res:
            break
        results.extend(res)
        page_index+=1
    # Exact-match post-filter on first + last
    exact=[r for r in results if r.get('first_name','').lower()==first.lower() and r.get('last_name','').lower()==last.lower()]
    return exact

payloads=[]
rows=[]
for full in invitees:
    first,last=parse_name(full)
    exact=resolve_email_for_full_name(full)
    if len(exact)!=1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected 1 exact phone contact match for '{full}', got {len(exact)}")
    email=exact[0].get('email')
    # Fill placeholders (currently only invitee_first_name, but do generically)
    mapping={'invitee_first_name': first, 'invitee_last_name': last, 'invitee_full_name': full}
    body=body_template
    for ph in placeholders:
        key=ph
        if key in mapping:
            body=body.replace('{'+ph+'}', mapping[key])
        else:
            raise RuntimeError(f"No mapping available for placeholder {{{ph}}}")
    # Ensure no unreplaced placeholders remain
    leftover=set(re.findall(r"\{([^{}]+)\}", body))
